_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Mu maina Golf (Permainan Karta) - Pemain {player_id}.
Tujuan: Nai ri nilai terendah total ri ronde sibawa. Na kolumu nai nilai sama, nai dijumlah 0.
Nilai Karta: A=1, 2-10=nilai muka, J/Q=10, K=0

Aksi (guna kurung tepat):
- '[draw]' - Mu nai ri tumpukan
- '[take]' - Mu nallae ri pile nallae
- '[swap X Y]' - Mu ganti karta nai ri posisi X (baris) Y (kolom)
- '[discard]' - Mu nallae karta nai

board.drew:
Mu riolle: {card}
Riolo kutika [swap X Y] atau [discard] iye.
board.took:
Mu nallae: {card} ri pile nallae
Kutika [swap X Y] nainappa iye (tena nallae ri discard).

options.must_swap: Kutika: [swap X Y] (tena nallae ri pile nallae)

message.deck_empty: Dek'e kosong! Maccappa toni wettu e.
message.knocked: Pemain {pid} nakkok! Pemain-pemain lainna makkasoi satu giliran lai.
message.final_round: Pemain {pid} {reason}! Setiap pemain lain mendapat satu giliran lagi.

invalid.wrong_action: Guna tepat SATU aksi kurung: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], atau [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Kutika riolo [draw], [take], [knock], atau [peek X Y] sibawa
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Aja' mupuadai kartu iya ripigau pole acculeng. Harusu'ko pasellei iyaro.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Mu riolle karta. Kutika [swap X Y] atau [discard] iye.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisi di luar batas. Guna baris 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Aja' muwelliwi sibawa kartu iya ripallebbangi. Ullei giliranna riyolo'.
